memory_bridge: Organize the dense family into three panels. SIGNS: 以下 uses On カ for a limit below, while a conductor calls GET OFF at 下車 to retrieve On ゲ. POSITION AND LEVERS: 下（した） is below; someone 下げる（さげる） an object, while it 下がる（さがる） by itself. DOWNWARD PATHS: a traveler 下る（くだる） a route or 下りる（おりる） from a vehicle; a respected person above 下さる（くださる） a gift. The panels separate location, agency, travel, and honorific giving.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 以下（いか）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A limit line labeled 以下（いか） keeps every allowed amount at or below it. The exact word “at most; below” anchors On カ without the weak CAP fragment.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下車（げしゃ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The conductor calls GET OFF as the passenger 下車（げしゃ）. The opening sound of GET retrieves On ゲ, and the compound means “get off a vehicle.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下（した）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Place the lower platform directly beneath the baseline and label the position 下（した）—below. The standalone location word anchors した.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下げる（さげる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A worker pulls a lever and 下げる（さげる） the platform—lowers it. Someone acts on the object, so this is transitive.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下がる（さがる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Release the lever and the platform 下がる（さがる）—goes down by itself. This is the intransitive partner.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下る（くだる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A traveler follows the mountain road downward and 下る（くだる）—descends along it. The route scene distinguishes this from merely being below.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下さる（くださる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A respected person above lowers a gift into your hands and 下さる（くださる） it—honorifically gives it. Keep this social register attached to the full verb.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 下りる（おりる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The passenger steps down from the train and 下りる（おりる）—gets off. The vehicle-exit scene distinguishes it from descending a route with くだる.
